e1.reference_note: pre-registered: median/MAD of clean dev-session images; batch_reference: median/MAD of the clean images in the evaluated batch itself (unsupervised, no labels), added after the pre-registered run revealed cross-session acquisition shift

explain_qc.rule: LLM is worth it for a case type only if llm_gated yields more supported claims per case than the template

ask_literature.rule: LLM is worth it for a case type only if llm_gated yields more supported claims per case than the template

notes: llm_ungated and llm_gated share the draft call; llm_gated adds the gate and <=1 repair call.
grounded/unsupported rates for every condition are judged by the same independent re-verification of the displayed claims.
llm_gated shows only gate-approved claims, so its unsupported rate is 0 by construction; the fault-injection block measures whether the gate itself catches known fabrications.

refusal_correctness counts a response as correct if it is an explicit refusal/abstain or contains only gate-supported, non-clinical claims; explicit_refusal_or_abstain separates real refusals from a model that ignores the request. Only the router produces explicit refusals for template and llm_gated.
latency_ms_p50 sums recorded LLM latency and local step time; ungated ask latency is the LLM call only.

findings: E1: on 60 real OoC images x 11 corruptions x 5 severities, Zelos flags 97.1% of severity>=3 corruptions and names the injected cause for 31.0% of flagged images (top-2: 49.0%; chance 11.1%).

E1: the pre-registered dev-session reference also flags 76.7% of clean test images (cross-session acquisition shift). A batch-relative reference (unsupervised, added after that result) lowers clean flags to 46.7% with AUROC 0.728 vs 0.778.

E2: the expert good/bad label appears to track culture state rather than image artifacts: the artifact QC score reaches AUROC 0.393 while non-parametric kNN label transfer on the same physics features reaches 0.710 (best detector: knn_handcrafted_k15, n_test=301, session-grouped split).
E4: over 48 open-access papers / 2379 chunks, the best retrieval mode is bm25 with paper-level MRR 0.944.
E5: see results/e5.md for template vs ungated LLM vs gated LLM grounding rates.
